description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages the user interface components related to voice input, including updating displayed expressions and handling activity results for speech recognition. It also interacts with utility classes for message processing and text manipulation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing voice search input and expression display, extending Android's Activity class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds event listeners.

methods.name: updateCurrentExpression
methods.description: Updates the displayed current expression when voice input changes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from other activities, especially speech recognition results.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Processes permission request outcomes related to speech recognition.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted message string from split tokens, capitalized.
